description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the GlobalCommandResponseRegistry class, including registering command types, parsing JSON objects into command responses, and exception handling during parsing.

classes.name: GlobalCommandResponseRegistryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionalities of the GlobalCommandResponseRegistry, including type registration, JSON parsing, and exception handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by obtaining an instance of GlobalCommandResponseRegistry and creating an empty DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryKnowsJsonTypeTestCommand
methods.description: Tests that the registry correctly recognizes the type of TestCommandResponse.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryParsesTestJsonObject
methods.description: Tests parsing a JSON object with a valid type into a TestCommandResponse object.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryWrapsExceptionInDittoJsonException
methods.description: Ensures that missing or invalid JSON leads to a DittoJsonException being thrown.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryThrowsJsonTypeNotParsableException
methods.description: Verifies that providing a JSON object with an unrecognized type throws a JsonTypeNotParsableException.
